summary.text: Mike Moon, a Republican from Ash Grove, represents Missouri Senate District 29 (Barry, Christian, Lawrence and McDonald counties); he was elected in 2020 and re-elected in 2024.
He chairs the Senate Veterans and Military Affairs Committee and served in the Missouri House for District 157 from 2013 to 2020.

paragraphs.text: Moon was born in North Carolina and graduated from Western Branch High School in Chesapeake, Virginia.
He attended Baptist Bible College in Springfield, Missouri, and received a bachelor's degree in secondary education from Southwest Missouri State University in 1985.
He had a 28-year marketing career at Mercy Hospital and works as a cattle rancher in Lawrence and Christian counties.
The Locke and Smith Foundation named him Most Constitutionally Voting Legislator from 2017 to 2023.
Moon and his wife, Denise, have five children; he is a deacon and Sunday school teacher at High Street Baptist Church.
